title: Frame/legacy parity checklist — cancel tree, true compaction, true budget and FIFO queue landed

acceptance.cancelTree: agent.cancel with sessionId cancels child turns before the parent turn and clears the queue; CancelTreeStopsChildBeforeParent
acceptance.confirmTimeout: confirmation waits expire per call key without dropping sibling pendings; ConfirmationTimeoutRemovesOnlyTheExpiredGate
acceptance.removeTimeout: linked question timeouts clear the matching gate; RemoveTimeoutClearsLinkedQuestion
acceptance.trueCompaction: session.compact summarizes through the gateway pool, keeps anchor plus tail groups and fires compactStarted plus compacted; TrueCompactionKeepsTailAndFiresCompacted
acceptance.compactReject: prompts during compaction fail COMPACTING and bump the reject counter; CompactingSessionRejectsPromptAndCountsReject
acceptance.cancelCompaction: session.compact with cancel stops a running compaction; CancelCompactionFlagStopsRunningCompaction
acceptance.budgetFields: usage.query carries maxTokens, usagePercentage, occupancyState and usedIsEstimated from real tokens; UsageQueryCarriesBudgetFields
acceptance.budgetLimit: denied budgets end the turn as RATE_LIMITED before gateway traffic; BudgetExceededEmitsRateLimited
acceptance.queueFifo: agent.queue, agent.drain and agent.unqueue keep memory FIFO order with depth; QueueKeepsFifoOrderAndDrainStartsPrompt
acceptance.retryOrigin: agent.retry replays the last user text with retriedFrom; RetryCarriesRetriedFrom
acceptance.observableMetrics: system.info exposes cancel counts, compact rejects and queue depth; SystemInfoExposesCancelAndQueueMetrics
acceptance.titleDetails: session.title locks explicitly and surfaces NO_USER_MESSAGE plus lock rejection; TitleLockAndFailureDetails
acceptance.emissionCodes: RATE_LIMITED and COMPACTING each fire at least once across the station suite (contract codes stay frozen; title failures travel as details NO_USER_MESSAGE, NO_PROVIDER, TITLE_PARSE_EMPTY, TITLE_SAVE_FAILED with NO_API_KEY and TITLE_TIMEOUT host-side)
acceptance.rollback: HALO_ENGINE_COMPACT, HALO_ENGINE_BUDGET and HALO_ENGINE_QUEUE switches fall back to char stub plus stub queue with no contract change

history.note: session.list/get paged read matches legacy; workspace-scoped, no silent full scan (inherited, still green)
history rows carry id, tool calls, tokens and reasoning; compaction rewrites keep anchor plus tail groups with a system summary (inherited, still green)
session.delete removes child sessions too — scheduled with the cutover station
list/get filter by workspace, no silent full scan; compaction resolves workspace per descriptor (inherited, still green)
frame page maps to render messages (inherited, still green)
prompt echo plus matching turn.done settle and incremental catch-up (inherited, still green)

tool.note: tool.start carries argsPreview/policy, tool.delta fires at most once per oversized call, tool.end carries success/output/exitCode/durationMs/fileBytes/errorCode/errorPayload/spilledFile/images/validatedWarnings/truncated (inherited, still green)

write approval and ask_user confirm carry argsPreview/policy/timeoutSec/sessionId; ask_user additionally carries questions/questionYaml/ticketId; confirmation waits expire per call key and clear through the linked timeout path (inherited, still green)
engine returns the [SUBAGENT_INTERNAL] marker shape with parent linkage; sub-session Barrier fan-out stays on the legacy chain until the cutover station

turn.note: agent.prompt and agent.retry both run the detached loop with live deltas and real tool dispatch when the gateway and runner handles are set; retry carries retriedFrom and bumps the retry counter
agent.cancel stays on the fastest path for a single turn and fans out child-before-parent for a session tree, including linked question cleanup and queue clearing
turn.failed keeps the frozen reason set; budget overruns use RATE_LIMITED only and compaction contention uses COMPACTING with an observable reject counter

usage.note: usage.tick/query carry real input/output/cached tokens with maxTokens, usagePercentage, occupancyState and usedIsEstimated from the cached budget snapshot; backend overruns end turns as RATE_LIMITED while the display bar cutover stays with the settings station
